architecture.continuityState: Harness-managed durable Run continuity preserves execution identities, digests, budgets, causal links and effect evidence independently from exact model or Tool content
architecture.privacyAuthority: HarnessRunContract privacy flags govern Harness-managed durable content; recovery convenience does not expand authority
architecture.providerV4: Provider Call v4 can prove COMPLETED plus the exact AgentTurnResult digest without retaining the AgentTurnResult object
architecture.workingViewMaterialization: Working View source materialization is policy-aware at the Continuity boundary while SQLiteHarnessStore remains a mechanical CAS/Journal primitive

behavior.metadataOnly: exact model transcript, Provider result content, structured Tool arguments/observations, dynamic Provider error detail, unauthorized Trace payloads and terminal conclusion/proposal content are omitted or digest-projected from Harness-managed durable state
behavior.mixedAuthority: model-content permission does not directly authorize structured Tool channels; Tool-role messages, Tool Calls, Tool arguments and Tool Observation objects require Tool-content authority
behavior.providerResponseLoss: a metadata-only completed Provider Call remains durably fenced by completion/result digest and is never physically redispatched merely because exact result bytes were not retained
behavior.rehydration: when exact content was intentionally not retained, cross-process continuation fails closed and requires caller-authorized rehydration rather than reconstructing hidden content
behavior.sameProcess: current in-memory Agent/Tool observations remain usable during the active execution; Repository Repair conclusion validation uses ephemeral bound observations instead of treating durable Store content as working memory
behavior.terminalEvidence: metadata-only terminal Run evidence remains reopenable as receipt/digests/redacted Trace even when exact conclusion, CompletionProposal and Tool Observation content were not retained

conclusion: P-C1.2a closes the durable-content authority gap exposed after P-C1.1: Harness execution continuity no longer requires the default metadata-only policy to secretly retain private transcript, Provider-result or Tool-observation bytes. Exact content and effect safety are now separate laws: omitted content can require rehydration while completed physical effects remain fenced against redispatch.
knownLimits: Caller-authorized content rehydration is not yet a first-class API; metadata-only cross-process continuation that needs omitted transcript/result/Tool content currently fails closed.

Privacy enforcement is structural rather than semantic taint tracking. If model-content retention is allowed, ordinary model text may semantically repeat Tool-derived information that Harness cannot identify as Tool provenance.

SQLiteHarnessStore is deliberately a low-level mechanical storage authority. A privileged caller that directly writes arbitrary objects can persist its own bytes outside the Run-level privacy boundary; Continuity still refuses to admit unauthorized Working View content as valid cognition history.

The mature OrdivonAgentLoop still builds its current in-memory model view around a transcript list. P-C1.2a repairs durable privacy authority but does not yet migrate the mature multi-turn loop to replaceable WorkingView projection.
WorkingViewNoToolTurnRunner remains a narrow P-C1.1 prototype and is not exported from the recommended ordivon_harness.api surface.
